Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Aliyah is not innovative.

% Anyone who speaks confidently or writes clearly can communicate complex ideas.

axiom(s6, not(works_independently(aliyah))).

% Aliyah either thinks logically or trusts her instinct, but not both.
axiom(s7, xor(thinks_logically(aliyah),trusts_instinct(aliyah))).

axiom(s8, not(evaluates_data_effectively(aliyah))).

% For Aliyah, being able to communicate complex ideas and being reliable in findings are mutually exclusive.

% Everyone who approaches problems systematically either thinks logically or considers multiple perspectives (or both).

% Aliyah does not have attention to detail.
axiom(s13, not(has_attention_to_detail(aliyah))).

% Aliyah is accurate or innovative.
axiom(s14, or(accurate(aliyah),innovative(aliyah))).

% Aliyah meets deadlines.
axiom(s15, meets_deadlines(aliyah)).

% If Aliyah is precise in measurements, then she either has attention to detail or makes accurate conclusions (but not both).
axiom(s16, rule([precise_in_measurements(aliyah)],xor(has_attention_to_detail(aliyah),makes_accurate_conclusions(aliyah)))).
